# SIA DAGAR

> SIA DAGAR (DAGAR) is a Latvia-based company providing project management and
> consulting services since 2012, headquartered in Riga. It operates across
> Latvia, Poland, Ukraine, Lithuania and Estonia.

## About

DAGAR delivers full-cycle project management and consulting. The company works
with clients internationally and focuses on reliable, on-time delivery with a
focused approach in every industry.

## Services (project management & consulting in these areas)

- Energy: industrial gas supply; renewable energy — biogas and biomethane.
- Business Development: developing new markets, partnerships and growth directions.
- Product Development: product design and development, from concept to market.
- ICT: information and communication technology solutions and projects.

## Markets

Latvia (LV), Poland (PL), Ukraine (UA), Lithuania (LT), Estonia (EE).
